la:noun:pe.gloss: The name of the Latin script letter P/p.
senses: The name of the Latin script letter P/p.
la:noun:pe.html:
-pe, an enclitic particle with an intensive force
Sauscr. -pa, -pi, which is similarly used; cf. -que
, as in prope, nempe, quippe; and appearing as p in quispiam, uspiam, etc. (cf. Corss. Ausspr. 2, 846).
la:noun:pe.inflection: an enclitic particle with an intensive force
